decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the dwelling hereby permitted shall match those specified in the Letter received 16th June 2009 and drawings 582/RDP/P01 and 582/RDP/P02 received 12th August 2009 and information received 24th August 2009.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (00, dated 30/04/13, received 16/07/13; 01, dated 30/04/13, received 16/07/13; 02, dated 30/04/13, received 16/07/13; 03, dated 30/04/13, received 16/07/13; 04, dated 30/04/13, received 16/07/13; 05, dated 30/04/13, received 16/07/13; and 06, dated 30/04/13, received 16/07/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The windows formed in the side elevations and side roof shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details in drawing 582/RDP/LS01 and landscaping specification for planting and maintenance received 16th June 2009.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 7 - All boundary treatment shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details in drawing 582/RDP/LS01 received 16th June 2009 and information received 24th August 2009.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 8 - The front access doorway to the dwelling hereby permitted shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.
description: Variation of conditions 3 (approved plans) and 5 (windows) of permission 00647/K/P1for erection of a five bedroom detached dwelling house to site.
